clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger watches the northern trails for threats. The orc scout directs Horde fighters against Witchwing harpies in the Dry Hills, whose raids endanger travelers and settlements. He is also an old friend of Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin.

Darsok Swiftdagger watches the northern scrubland from the Crossroads. The roads linking Durotar, Mulgore, and the Barrens’ northern reaches face raiders and centaur, as well as organized hunters from the sky. Darsok’s anger falls on the Witchwing harpies. Their roosts lie in the Dry Hills, northwest of the Forgotten Pools, where they threaten caravans traveling north.

Darsok has an old friend far northwest of the Barrens: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, a troll who lives at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, the land the harpies come from. Darsok sends Jin'Zil a letter with news of the harpy campaign. The two friends have not been in touch for many years.
